candidates.name: Coverage Implementation Schema 1.1
verified_facts: CIS establishes a format-independent implementable coverage model and supports multiple encodings.
Coverage instances still require a concrete encoding in an implementation.
semantic_limits: Conformance to the coverage model does not prove the source grid resolution, acquisition date, terrain semantics, vertical datum or numerical accuracy of coverage values.

candidates.name: Web Map Service
verified_facts: WMS provides an HTTP interface for requesting geo-registered map images for selected layers and an area of interest.
Responses are display-oriented images such as PNG or JPEG.
semantic_limits: A WMS image is not the original numeric coverage and must not be sampled as if it were authoritative DTM elevation data unless an independent numeric-source contract proves equivalence.
